awards.title: Awards & Achievements
awards.description: Recognition for academic excellence, hackathon victories, and competitive achievements.

items.name: Riverflex Augmented Intelligence Hackathon
items.description: Handpicked to participate in an exclusive AI hackathon with global retail clients. Developed an AI-native Customer Relationship Management prototype to tackle real-world business challenges.
items.achievement: Created AI-native CRM prototype blending strategic creativity with engineering to solve retail industry challenges

items.name: Imperial / Viriden Hackathon
items.description: Developed a machine learning model for carbon capture analysis using 4D seismic data. Applied clustering algorithms to identify significant geological changes in CO2 reservoirs over time.
items.achievement: Built ML model to detect significant seismic changes and spatial patterns in carbon capture reservoirs using threshold-based analysis and clustering

items.name: KPMG Ideation Challenge
items.description: Recognized as the top team in Turkey for the KPMG Ideation Challenge. Developed CoPeer, a B2B wellness platform designed to connect therapists privately with employees, promoting workplace mental health.
items.achievement: Collaborated remotely with a Turkey-based team to create a minimum viable product in a competitive, innovation-focused environment. Presented our work to global KPMG executives as global finalists.

items.name: Merit Scholarship
items.description: Full merit scholarship of $30,000 annually at Koç University
items.details: Awarded based on academic excellence and maintained throughout undergraduate studies
